why: The standard array is 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8; the human adds +1 to all six abilities, and the level 4 Ability Score Improvement adds +2 Wisdom (vaults/phb/Contents/03 - Chapter 1- Step-By-Step Characters.md, Ability Scores; vaults/phb/Contents/04 - Chapter 2- Races.md, Human; vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Ability Score Improvement).
A 5th-level character has proficiency bonus +3 (vaults/phb/Contents/03 - Chapter 1- Step-By-Step Characters.md, Character Advancement).
Cleric hit points are 8 at level 1, then the fixed 5 per later level, plus Constitution modifier +2 at each level: 8 + 4×5 + 5×2 = 38 (vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Hit Points).
Chain mail gives AC 16, and the shield adds 2 (vaults/phb/Contents/19 - Chapter 5- Equipment.md, Armor and Shields).

Cleric saving throw proficiencies are Wisdom and Charisma; proficient saves add +3 to the ability modifier (vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Proficiencies; vaults/phb/Contents/21 - Chapter 7- Using Ability Scores.md, Saving Throws).

Acolyte grants Insight and Religion; the Cleric choices are History and Medicine. Each adds its ability modifier and +3 when proficient (vaults/phb/Contents/18 - Chapter 4- Personality and Background.md, Acolyte; vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Proficiencies; vaults/phb/Contents/21 - Chapter 7- Using Ability Scores.md, Skills). Initiative is the Dexterity modifier +1 (vaults/phb/Contents/23 - Chapter 9- Combat.md, Initiative).

At Cleric 5, Wisdom modifier +4 plus Cleric level 5 gives nine prepared spells; the Cleric knows four cantrips and has 4/3/2 spell slots. Spell save DC is 8 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier = 15, and spell attacks add proficiency and Wisdom modifier = 7 (vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Spellcasting and The Cleric table; vaults/phb/Contents/24 - Chapter 10- Spellcasting.md, Spell Save DC). Life Domain spells are always prepared and don't count against the prepared total (vaults/phb/Contents/20 - Chapter 6- Customization Options.md, Life Domain).
Channel Divinity has one use at Cleric 5, recovering on a short or long rest (vaults/phb/Contents/08 - Cleric.md, Channel Divinity and The Cleric table).
Religion is an Intelligence skill: -1 + 3 = 2. The first version of this sheet had 5.
